title: ISRO exit rules tightened amid reports of 100 scientists quitting
summary: The Department of Space (DoS) has issued a fresh directive asking ISRO centres not to routinely accept resignation or voluntary retirement requests from scientific and technical personnel linked to Gaganyaan and other key missions, amid reports of a sharp rise in exits from the space agency.
